title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E06 — Denver McKee
The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E07 — Day of Reckoning
Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E08 — The Abduction
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

title: Wildfire
description: Two horse-traders (Bob Steele, Sterling Holloway) find their problem is a rustler (John Miljan), not a wild horse.

title: Enemy of the Law
description: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

title: Shine on Harvest Moon
description: Former partner Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).

title: Adventures of Gallant Bess
description: A rodeo stunt rider (Cameron Mitchell) meets a woman (Audrey Long) who comes between him and his trick horse, Bess.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Phantom Ranger
description: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E21 — Pancho Held Hostage
Cisco and Pancho capture a notorious bank robber after falling for a trap set by the criminal's sister.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E22 — Freight Line Feud
Cisco and Pancho attempt to convince a freighting company owner that her competitor did not steal from her wagons.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E23 — Phony Sheriff
A phony sheriff is part of a rustling scheme.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E24 — Uncle Disinherits Niece
Cisco and Pancho discover the shady motives of a lawyer hired to change a rancher's will.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E19 — Harry Tracy
Harry Tracy terrorized America's northwest at the end of the 19th century; Matt and a posse have cornered the outlaw.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E20 — The Wild Bunch of Wyoming
Matt and Frankie follow Butch Cassidy to South America.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E22 — Little Britches
A young woman meets an outlaw; Matt investigates a railroad holdup.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E21 — The Doolin Gang
Frankie poses as a gang member's wife but gets caught.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E17 — The Brute
Needed winter supplies are being stolen before they can reach the village; Tim, a simple-minded man, is made to believe he killed someone and when he flees he becomes an easy scapegoat.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E18 — Stubborn Pioneer
Carpenter heads into the wilderness to establish a new settlement; Hawkeye and Chingachgook try to prevent disaster.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E19 — The Promised Valley
A Tuscarawas brave tries to start a war between his people and the white men.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E20 — The Girl
A young woman with a past and a Seneca Chief attempt to stir the Iroquois into war with the settlers.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E21 — The Soldier
A young soldier is accused of stealing new breech-loading rifles and selling them to the Indians; he is being tried for treason unless Hawkeye can discover the truth.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E22 — Huron Tomahawk
Mike is returning home to marry but his fiancé and family have been murdered in what appears to be a Huron raid.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E23 — Tolliver Gang
Tolliver and his outlaw gang of former pirates have kidnapped two women and demanded a ransom of 1000 pounds; Hawkeye infiltrates the gang in an attempt to get them back.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E24 — The Colonel and His Lady
Chief Black Wolf and his tribe are accused of breaking the treaty; it is up to Hawkeye and Chingachgook to clear them.

title: Wagon Wheels
description: An Oregon Trail scout (Randolph Scott) woos a member (Gail Patrick) of his wagon train in Indian country.

title: Under Western Stars
description: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

title: The Cowboy and the Prizefighter
description: Red Ryder KO's a fight racket with sidekick Little Beaver and a new friend.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: Wagon Trail
description: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

title: The Sundowners
description: Texas brothers (Robert Preston, Robert Sterling) feud over land and cattle, with a younger brother between them.

title: American Empire
description: Three men (Richard Dix, Leo Carrillo, Preston Foster) start a big cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas, but greed destroys it.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Mason of the Mounted
description: A young constable searches for a murderer and finds the suspect managing a prosperous horse-stealing gang.

title: The Gay Cavalier
description: The Cisco Kid (Gilbert Roland) and Pancho (Martin Garralaga) try to help an unhappy bride.

title: Crashing Thru
description: Sgt. Renfrew (James Newill) and Constable Kelly (Warren Hull) are traveling on a cargo freighter when they meet Ann (Jean Carmen), a charming young woman who, unbeknownst to them, is part of a gang that plans to steal the freighter's gold shipment.

title: Sunset Carson Rides Again
description: A cowboy's partner tries to swindle him out of his land and the money he raised to build a new school.

title: Texas, Brooklyn and Heaven
description: A would-be playwright (Guy Madison) and a runaway (Diana Lynn) leave Texas and fall in love in New York.

title: Code of the Fearless
description: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Heartland
description: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.

title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Hell Town
description: A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.

title: Daughter of the West
description: A convent-raised woman (Martha Vickers) learns of her American Indian heritage through romance with an educated Navajo (Philip Reed) during the 1880s.

title: The Last of the Clintons
description: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

title: Land of Hunted Men
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, Dennis Moore, Max Terhune) track outlaws to their hide-out.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: A Lust to Kill
description: A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

title: Law of the Pampas
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekick (Russell Hayden) head for South America to deliver cattle.

title: Billy the Kid Returns
description: Singing Billy (Roy Rogers) settles a case of mistaken identity with his sidekick, Frog (Smiley Burnette).

title: Grand Canyon Trail
description: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

title: Bad Man of Deadwood
description: A cowboy (Roy Rogers) hides from his past in a fake professor's (George "Gabby" Hayes) medicine show and helps town outcasts fight civic reformers.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

title: Wildfire
description: Two horse-traders (Bob Steele, Sterling Holloway) find their problem is a rustler (John Miljan), not a wild horse.

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: Jesse James Rides Again
description: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: The Trail Beyond
description: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to search for missing people in Canada, and quickly finds out a gang of French Canadian outlaws have been kidnapping people.

title: Lost Canyon
description: After Johnny is accused of robbing a bank, he runs into the hills. When his friend Hopalong Cassidy hears what happened, Hopalong sets out to find the real bad guys.

title: Raiders of Red Gap
description: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.
